definitions.explanation: A shop where men get their hair cut; also refers to the barber who works there.

examples.japanese: {床屋|とこや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ってきます→行く：00119_iku⟧。

examples.english: I got my hair cut at the barbershop.
Is there a barbershop around here?

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{床屋|とこや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っています→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My father always goes to the same barbershop.

examples.japanese: {床屋|とこや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had them cut it short at the barbershop.

notes:
{床屋|とこや} traditionally refers to men's barbershops.

BARBERSHOP vs HAIR SALON:
- {床屋|とこや}/{理髪店|りはつてん}: barbershop (traditionally for men)
- {美容院|びよういん}/{美容室|びようしつ}: hair salon (originally for women, now unisex)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {床屋|とこや}に{行|い}く: to go to the barber
- {床屋|とこや}で{髪|かみ}を{切|き}る: to get a haircut at the barber

Note: Younger generations often use {美容院|びよういん} regardless of gender. {床屋|とこや} can sound slightly old-fashioned.
